summary: community.aws deprecates aws_* module aliases such as aws_acm, aws_api_gateway, aws_batch_* and aws_codebuild in favor of their canonical community.aws names.
questions: What should I use instead of aws_acm?
What is the new name for aws_codebuild?

answer_card.title: community.aws deprecated aliases (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
Use the canonical FQCN instead of the deprecated alias:

- `aws_acm_info` → `community.aws.acm_certificate_info`
- `aws_acm` → `community.aws.acm_certificate`
- `aws_api_gateway_domain` → `community.aws.api_gateway_domain`
- `aws_api_gateway` → `community.aws.api_gateway`
- `aws_application_scaling_policy` → `community.aws.application_autoscaling_policy`
- `aws_batch_compute_environment`, `aws_batch_job_definition`, `aws_batch_job_queue` → `community.aws.batch_*`
- `aws_codebuild` → `community.aws.codebuild_project`
